summary: Pyxis Oncology filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten public offering of common stock plus accompanying common warrants, with pre-funded warrants offered in lieu of stock to certain investors. Each share or pre-funded warrant sells with one common warrant; the pre-funded exercise price is $0.001. Common warrants carry an unspecified exercise price, expire the earlier of five years after the charter amendment effective date or 30 days after the MICVO overall survival data release, and are not exercisable until stockholder approval of a charter amendment increasing authorized shares. PYXS closed at $2.90 on September 28, 2026. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
